Wanderlust for homebird's - a young couple have solved the problem of leaving a much loved home to go travelling, by strapping a downsized version to the back of their pick-up and taking it with them.

Patrick Howard and Lauren Kennedy ditched their office jobs, sold most of their worldly possessions and their 2,000 sq ft home and bought the miniscule 200 sq ft house, which can be towed by a pick-up truck.

The pair, who were both electrical engineers, are now on their trip of a lifetime travelling all over the United States with their two dogs, Otis and Colbie.

They are part of the Tiny House Movement - a growing group of people who are buying small houses and enjoying simpler lives.
